tha-ap19:7.4:
bhavissati → machasaṃ, sī.selu, PTS potthakesu imissā gāthāya ṭhāne 
“yaṃ vadanti sumedhoti bhūripaññaṃ sumedhasaṃ 
kappe’to satasahasse esa buddho bhavissatī” iti. ayaṃ gāthā dissati.
tha-ap19:9.2: satthusāvako → “samantapāsādikatāya aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapessatī”ti gāthaddhopi theragāthaṭṭha kathāyaṃ dissati.
